name: dragino-lse01
description: LoRaWAN soil moisture & EC sensor: soil water content, conductivity and battery (default MOD=0 uplink)
caveats: 1) Soil temperature (bytes 6-7) OMITTED: every official source (manual and all 4 decoder versions incl. ChirpStackV4 V1.2.1 and the TTN device repository) decodes negatives as (raw-0xFFFF)/100, which differs from two's-complement i16 (raw-0x10000)/100 by exactly 0.01 °C on every negative reading (manual example FF7E: official -1.29 vs i16 -1.30). Sub-zero soil temps occur in real deployments, so the table grammar cannot reproduce the official output; per the exactness rule the field was dropped rather than shipped 0.01 °C off. 2) Bytes 2-3 OMITTED: documented as "Temperature (Reserve) — Ignore now" in the current manual; the official decoder still emits temp_DS18B20 from them (proper i16, /10), but including a reserved field would create a phantom 0.0 °C HA temperature entity (TTN screenshot shows TempC_DS18B20: 0.0). 3) Byte 10 OMITTED: bitmask-only flags (MOD = bit7, s_flag = bit4, i_flag = low nibble) — not expressible. 4) The codec assumes the default MOD=0 layout; if the user sets MOD=1 (raw/dielectric mode, bit7 of byte 10 set), bytes 4-9 change meaning and this codec silently misdecodes — layout switching is not expressible in the grammar. 5) Battery kept WITHOUT the decoder's & 0x3FFF mask: the LSE01 manual documents plain hex→mV (Ex 0x0B45 = 2885 mV) and defines no status bits in bits 14-15 (unlike LHT65); with a Li-SOCl2 supply ≤ ~3.6 V the raw value never reaches bit 14, so u16 and the masked value are identical in real frames. 6) Test vectors are assembled from the manual's per-field official examples, not captured over the air — no complete example frame is published; validate.py was actually executed on the file (passes).
